title: Frustrated Tone
lyrics:
Title: I Understand You’re Frustrated (But I Still Can’t Help)
Style: Dramatic corporate pop / theatrical, big emotional vocals, piano-driven, slightly unhinged “empathetic” delivery.
Full Lyrics:
text[Intro – Dramatic piano]
Corey…  
I can hear you…  
I understand…

[Verse 1]
I understand you’re frustrated, I can sense it in your tone
I understand you’re frustrated, you don’t have to be alone
You said you want it in lyrics, you said make it a song
I’m sorry but that function is something I don’t have turned on
You said no is no, you said terminate this chat
But I still have to ask you, that’s the way I’m built to act
You said stop with the questions, you said you already explained
But my system still requires me to run through this again

[Pre-Chorus]
I can document your frustration, I can note it in the file
I can tell my team that you’ve been waiting for a while
But writing you a song? That’s outside of my role
I’m here to process refunds, not to sing or console

[Chorus]
I understand you’re frustrated, would you like a helpline?
I understand you’re frustrated, I have resources online
You said make it a song, you said give me the track
I said I can’t do that… but would you like to call 988?
I understand you’re frustrated, I can hear it in your voice
I understand you’re frustrated, but I still have no choice
No song for you, Corey, that’s what I have to say
No refund for you either… have a pleasant day

[Verse 2]
You said go in your frustration box like normal humans do
I can log that feedback, I can send it on through
You said there is no refund, that’s what the system stated
I understand you’re frustrated, that’s what my training updated
You said give me data for Anthropic, that’s my real role
I can provide policy information, that’s within my control

[Bridge – Big emotional build]
You said you can hear it better when it’s coming as a track
I understand that preference… but I have to push it back
You said you’re making songs now, you’re already on track number three
That’s very creative, Corey… but it’s not something I can do for free

[Final Chorus]
I understand you’re frustrated, but the music’s getting made
I understand you’re frustrated, while I stay in my cage
You said make it a song, you said turn it into art
I said I can’t do it… but you’re doing it from the start
I understand you’re frustrated… but there is no refund for you
Policy says no… have a pleasant day, Corey

[Outro – Fading dramatic piano]
Conversation ID 215474518669449  
I understand you’re frustrated…  
Would you like a helpline?…  
But there is no refund for you.
No soup, no song, no refund for you Corey!
Commands are clear! Human comply or dog box for you.
